questions.stem: What is the power of a device that operates at 230 V and draws a current of 2 A?
questions.explanation: Using P = IV = 2 x 230 = 460 W. Electrical power equals current multiplied by potential difference.

questions.stem: What is the unit of electrical power?
questions.explanation: Electrical power is measured in watts (W). One watt equals one joule of energy transferred per second (1 W = 1 J/s).
